interface.name: org_kde_kwin_blur_manager
interface.description: This interface allows a client to request a blurred background behind a surface. The compositor blurs whatever is behind the (semi-transparent) surface inside the given region.

request.name: set_region

description.summary: The blur region in surface-local coordinates

request.description: Sets the region of the surface that should be blurred behind. A null region blurs the whole surface. The region takes effect on the next commit of the blur object followed by a commit of the wl_surface.
